# Hero of Bitcoin

> An independent Game Boy-compatible adventure through Bitcoin culture, set in El Salvador.

## Digital game

- [Hero of Bitcoin Digital](https://heroofbitcoin.xyz/digital/): Instant download paid with Bitcoin or Lightning.
- [Release trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5puiZFbMUN4): Official Hero of Bitcoin release trailer on YouTube.
- [Playable demo](https://demo.heroofbitcoin.xyz): Try the game before buying.

## Product facts

- The download contains the game ROM, a PDF guide, and Windows launch files.
- The game is in English. The landing page supports English, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, German, Korean, French, Dutch, and Finnish.
- The product page shows a live BTC amount first, with smaller USD and EUR reference prices.
- Checkout calculates the authoritative price and locks the BTC amount when it opens.
- No account or email address is required for the digital order.
